description:
One conversation's messages, newest first. Poll forward with `after`
(the id of the newest message you already have) to get only new ones.
Page backward through history with `cursor`. Do not pass both.

(Tags: WhatsApp)

after.description: Return messages newer than this message id. `next_cursor` is null in this mode.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page. Do not combine it with `after`.

name: listWhatsappMessages
